title: Miami Yacht Charter Azimut 70ft and 2 Jet Skis 13 Guests
blurb:
IMPORTANT: THIS IS NOT AN ALL-INCLUSIVE OFFER.

Additional fees paid separately to third parties: 
* Marina Pick-Up Fee: $200
* Fuel Fee: $100/hr
Crew Payment: $100/hr

Per US Coast Guard bareboat charter regulations, these fees must be paid directly to third parties and cannot pass through our hands, as this would be illegal.

Set sail on a private luxury yacht rental in Miami, accommodating up to 13 people. Enjoy stunning views of the Brickell skyline and beautiful islands while you relax and let the crew navigate. Choose your itinerary, whether you want to swim, take photos, or listen to music. Customize your experience with a cooler for your drinks and enjoy the flexibility of various rental durations.

- Cruise past iconic Miami landmarks with a private yacht rental
- Flexible trip duration to fit your schedule
- Includes a cooler for personal drinks and a Bluetooth sound system
- Convenient pickup at the marina with a friendly crew to assist
